title: Check replacement Properties identity and Configuration progress
description: The native checker tracks the exact standard Properties object a caller installs and routes System accessors through that receiver, preserving defaults, old references and the cast of a setter result. Compare positive identity, inverse identity, a saved initializer value, defaults, prior non-String values and an unbound ambient table against fresh Temurin 21 executions. Then retry both Configuration upgrades with explicit empty, own and inherited tables to identify the next strict instruction.
expected: The directly installed table and its inverse have opposite native decisions. All returned positives agree with the unchanged JVM. Broader and profile-specific refusals name the operation that prevents a conclusion.

Retry the JSON caller with explicit tables
